title: Glucose-lowering drugs in type 2 diabetes: insulin sensitizers, insulin secretagogues, and drugs that alter absorption or excretion

groups.title: Insulin sensitizers
groups.desc: ↑ peripheral glucose use. No change in insulin release, so low hypoglycemia risk alone.

drugs.name: Biguanide: metformin
drugs.moa: Activates AMP kinase → ↓ gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis, ↑ hepatic insulin sensitivity. Excreted unchanged in urine.

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: eGFR < 30. Lactic acidosis, ↓ B12, GI upset.

drugs.name: Thiazolidinediones (TZDs)
drugs.moa: PPAR-γ agonists → adipocyte expansion, ↓ free fatty acids, ↑ muscle uptake. Gene transcription, so onset up to 3 months.

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: heart failure (edema), liver failure, osteoporosis (fractures), bladder cancer.

groups.title: Insulin secretagogues
groups.desc: ↑ insulin release from β-cells. Need functioning β-cells, so weaker in advanced disease.

drugs.name: Sulfonylureas
drugs.moa: Close the β-cell ATP-sensitive K⁺ channel → depolarize → Ca²⁺ in → insulin out. Fade over time (secondary failure).

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: elderly, living alone, drivers; renal or hepatic failure; pregnancy. Alcohol and CYP interactions.

drugs.name: Meglitinides
drugs.moa: Same channel, faster on and off → post-prandial control. Taken with each meal (three times daily).

lines.label: Note:
lines.text: inactive metabolites, so safer than sulfonylureas.

drugs.name: GLP-1 receptor agonists
drugs.moa: Mimic GLP-1 (×10): insulin only when glucose is high, ↓ glucagon, ↓ gastric emptying, ↑ satiety. Subcutaneous (oral semaglutide exists).

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: medullary thyroid cancer, MEN 2, pancreatic cancer. GI effects, pancreatitis.

drugs.name: DPP-4 inhibitors
drugs.moa: Block the enzyme that breaks down GLP-1 → endogenous GLP-1 ×2–3. Oral.

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: URTIs, pancreatitis; saxagliptin ↑ heart failure risk.

drugs.name: Tirzepatide (dual GLP-1 / GIP)
drugs.moa: Activates GLP-1 and GIP receptors (more GIP). ↓ appetite, ↓ BP, ↓ liver fat, ↓ albuminuria. Weekly injection.

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: interacts with oral contraceptives. GI effects, pancreatitis.

groups.title: Absorption or excretion
groups.desc: Work outside the β-cell, so low hypoglycemia risk alone.

drugs.name: α-Glucosidase inhibitor
drugs.moa: Competitively inhibits brush-border α-glucosidase → slower carbohydrate digestion, blunted post-meal peak. Must be taken with each meal.

drugs.name: SGLT2 inhibitors
drugs.moa: Block Na⁺/glucose cotransporter in the proximal convoluted tubule → glucose, Na⁺ and water lost in urine. Independent of insulin and β-cells.

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: volume depletion, UTIs and genital infections, fractures, amputations. Efficacy falls with renal function.
